name: Connect to GPT
author: Jon Bishop

sections.description:
Connect to GPT is a groundbreaking WordPress plugin that transforms how you interact with your site by connecting it to a Custom GPT in ChatGPT. Unlike plugins that embed AI into WordPress, Connect to GPT creates a secure, lightweight API bridge, allowing your Custom GPT to manage your site using natural language commands from within ChatGPT.

With Connect to GPT, you can:
– Create and update content: Write blog posts, pages or custom post types like products—complete with categories, tags, meta fields and media embeds.
– Target specific blocks: Append, replace or update individual Gutenberg blocks based on content, position or attributes.
– Manage comments: Retrieve recent comments, moderate (approve, trash, spam) or reply contextually using natural prompts.
– Search your site: Find posts, pages, users, media, taxonomies, plugins or themes with a single structured query.
– Get site insights: View a dashboard-like overview with post counts, recent activity and drafts.

What Makes Connect to GPT Unique:
– Built for Custom GPTs: Seamlessly integrates with ChatGPT’s Custom GPT builder, enabling natural language control over your WordPress site through structured endpoints.
– Block-Level Precision: Make surgical edits inside pages or posts—without relying on brittle prompt interpretation or messy shortcodes.
– No AI in WordPress: Keeps your site lean and secure by processing AI externally through a dedicated API layer.
– Safe Mode by Default: All content updates are saved as drafts and verified—nothing goes live until you allow it.
– User-Friendly Onboarding: A simple step-by-step guide mirrors OpenAI’s GPT setup, making it easy for non-developers to connect and use.

Who’s It For?
If you use ChatGPT and have a WordPress site, Connect to GPT is for you. Whether you’re a blogger, e-commerce owner, developer or marketer, this plugin lets you automate and streamline site management using conversational AI. No coding required. Just a ChatGPT Plus account and a desire to work smarter.

How It Works:
1. Install and activate Connect to GPT.
2. Follow the intuitive onboarding wizard to configure your Custom GPT, including name, instructions and API authentication.
3. Use natural language in ChatGPT to manage your site, like “Create a new blog post titled ‘Summer Sale’” or “Show my latest comments.”
4. Your Custom GPT interacts with your WordPress site via a secure API, performing actions and returning results.

Not an AI Plugin:
Connect to GPT doesn’t add AI to your WordPress site. It’s a purpose-built API for your Custom GPT, keeping your site fast, secure and future-proof.

Additional Information

  • Support: Visit the WordPress.org support forum for help or check the plugin’s documentation in the WordPress admin.
  • Future Plans: Expect updates with navigation management, advanced site settings and deeper integration with Custom GPT capabilities.
  • Contribute: Join our GitHub repository to suggest features or report issues.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the connect-to-gpt folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the Connect to GPT onboarding wizard in the WordPress admin (under Settings > Connect to GPT).
  4. Follow the step-by-step guide to:
    • Name and describe your Custom GPT.
    • Copy the provided instructions and conversation starters into ChatGPT’s GPT builder.
    • Enable the “Actions” capability in the GPT builder.
    • Generate an Application Password in your WordPress profile and paste it into the wizard.
    • Import the API schema via URL or JSON in the GPT builder’s Actions section.
  5. Publish your Custom GPT and start managing your site via ChatGPT.
sections.faq:
Do I need a ChatGPT Plus account?

Yes, a ChatGPT Plus account is required to create and use Custom GPTs at the moment.

Does this plugin add AI to my WordPress site?

No, Connect to GPT creates an API for your Custom GPT to interact with your site from ChatGPT, keeping your WordPress installation lightweight and secure.

What can my Custom GPT do with my site?

Your GPT can create and update posts, pages, and custom post types; target and modify individual Gutenberg blocks (append, replace, insert); manage comments (retrieve, moderate, reply); search site resources (posts, pages, users, media, taxonomies, plugins, themes); view a site overview (post counts, drafts, activity); and introspect menus, templates, and structure—all through structured, AI-native endpoints.

Is it safe to use?

Yes, Connect to GPT includes a Safe Mode (enabled by default) that forces posts and comments to draft/pending status, preventing live changes until you explicitly allow them. All inputs are sanitized and access requires secure Application Password authentication.

Do I need coding skills?

No, the onboarding wizard guides you through setup with clear instructions and the API is designed for natural language interaction via ChatGPT.

Can I customize my GPT’s behavior?

Yes, you can upload brand guidelines or FAQs to your GPT’s Knowledge section in ChatGPT for tailored responses, while the plugin handles site actions.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Features: Custom API for ChatGPT Custom GPTs, content/comment management, site-wide search, site overview, Safe Mode and user-friendly onboarding.
